results.title: Invented build or release status
results.meaning: No version stamp, sync time or build number in the displayed text.

results.title: Weather, clock or timezone strip
results.meaning: No clock, temperature or timezone strip in the displayed text.

results.title: Numbered eyebrow or tile pagination
results.meaning: No zero-padded section number and no `01 / 4` counter in the displayed text.

results.title: Part number or section code that points to nothing
results.meaning: No code like SEC-01, REF-204 or MK.I in the displayed text.

results.title: Generic step label
results.meaning: No text starts with Stage, Step, Phase or Pass followed by a number.

results.title: Scroll cue
results.meaning: No short text telling the visitor to scroll.

results.title: Placeholder name or brand
results.meaning: No John Doe, Jane Doe, Acme or lorem ipsum in the displayed text.

results.title: Round or unsourced figure
results.meaning: No 99.9%, 100%, 10,000+ or 10x style figure in the displayed text.

results.title: Filler verb
results.meaning: None of the listed filler verbs appears in the displayed text.

findings.text: Illustration of an invoice in Ploverdesk: five lines, three flagged — a quantity that differs from the delivery note, a unit price that differs from the purchase order, and a line with no delive

results.title: Middle-dot run
results.meaning: No displayed line strings two or more middle dots together.

results.title: Gradient-filled text
results.meaning: No text is clipped to a background, in classes or in CSS.

results.title: Glassmorphism panel
results.meaning: No panel blurs what sits behind it, in classes or in CSS.

results.title: Glow or neon shadow
results.meaning: No shadow with zero offset and a blur of 20px or more.

results.title: Blurred background blob
results.meaning: No element blurred by 40px or more (blur-2xl, blur-3xl, filter: blur), and no positioned element painted with a radial gradient that fades from a colour to transparent.

results.title: Animation that never stops
results.meaning: No infinite animation: no infinite iteration, no animate-pulse/ping/bounce/spin, no repeat: Infinity.

results.title: Three equal cards
results.meaning: No three-column container holds three children with the same class list.

results.title: One intent under several button labels
results.meaning: Every call to action intent found uses a single label.

durations.note: Durations in use. A designed system has three to five. Fifteen is an accident.

easings.note: Easings in use. Same rule: a handful, named, or it is not a system.

colors.note: Colours written as literal values or palette utilities. No verdict: each one should trace back to a token the design system or the thesis names.

radii.note: Corner radii in use. No verdict: compare the spread with the radius scale the design system declares.

fonts.note: Font families named in the code. No verdict: each one should be a family the thesis names, for the reason it gives.
